name: topicforge
description: Read-only ROS 2 and DDS inspection: list topics, sample messages, read bags, find QoS mismatches and see who is on the DDS bus. It cannot publish or command a robot.

dds_backend.title: DDS backend
dds_backend.description: cyclone joins the DDS bus as a read-only participant (needs no ROS 2). mock serves fixed demo data instead. auto picks the best available.

dds_domain_id.title: DDS domain id
dds_domain_id.description: The one DDS domain to observe, 0 to 232. It is fixed at startup; restart to change it.

tools.name: sample_messages
tools.description: Peek recent messages on a ROS 2 topic.

tools.name: list_participants
tools.description: DDS participants observed on a domain.

tools.name: detect_qos_mismatches
tools.description: Incompatible QoS pairs between DDS readers and writers.

tools.name: participant_events
tools.description: Timeline of participant discovered and lost events.

tools.name: topic_metrics
tools.description: Observed frequency, sequence gaps, latency percentiles.

tools.name: peek_bag_samples
tools.description: Peek decoded samples out of a recorded bag.

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: Normalized DDS writers and readers with QoS.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: ROS 2 nodes on the graph: names, namespaces, duplicates.

tools.name: get_node_info
tools.description: One node's topics, services, actions and parameters.
